Definition: an Arkite or native of Erek
BiblicalUsage: The Arkite is Hushai, David's friend, who meets him on the Mount of Olives when Absalom has taken Jerusalem. Hushai goes back into the city as David's man, and his counsel defeats the counsel of Ahithophel, which is what saves David.
TheologicalSignificance: One man's loyalty carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the reminder that God often saves His people through a friend who stays, and through counsel given at the right hour.
